name: @pixagram/upscaler
description: High-performance pixel art rendering engines with WebGL2 GPU acceleration and SIMD WebAssembly support

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:threads && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:wasm: RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+simd128" wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir dist/wasm && npm run build:wasm:cleanup
scripts.build:wasm:threads: RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals,+simd128 -C link-arg=--shared-memory -C link-arg=--max-memory=1073741824 -C link-arg=--import-memory -C link-arg=--export=__wasm_init_tls -C link-arg=--export=__tls_size -C link-arg=--export=__tls_align -C link-arg=--export=__tls_base -C link-arg=--export=__heap_base -C link-arg=--export=__data_end" rustup run nightly wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir dist/wasm-threads -- --features parallel -Z build-std=panic_abort,std && npm run build:wasm:cleanup
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build:all
